about_the_game:
Story Overview

A recently laid-off musician unexpectedly comes across a mysterious girl, Alice, on the street after a farewell party with his former coworkers. After carefully looking after her, Alice gradually regains her health—only to reveal her true identity as a succubus. To cover their living expenses, they begin to rise in fame on a live-streaming platform! Can the musician help Alice recover all her memories and achieve a happy ending?

Character Introduction

Alice
A mysterious woman found unconscious on the street and taken in by the protagonist. As the story progresses, her true identity as a succubus is revealed, along with hints of an even deeper secret...

short_description: A recently laid-off musician finds a girl on the street—only to discover that she’s a succubus! To make ends meet, they team up and start live-streaming music online. A rhythmic music game meets visual romance novel—experience a sweet life with a charming succubus!
